pr_body:
# Add EndpointMetadataCollection.GetRequiredMetadata

I've added GetRequiredMetadata<T>() method to  Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.EndpointMetadataCollection. It throws InvalidOperationException when metadata of type T is not found.

## Description
Fixes #39921

review_comments:
```suggestion
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public T GetRequiredMetadata<T>() where T : class
```
Does this method also need `AggressiveInlining` like the other one?
https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/0bc20453b290fa72a913fe4744cdcdff64663a1e/src/Http/Http.Abstractions/src/Routing/EndpointMetadataCollection.cs#L72-L73
AFAIK throwing an exception prevents a method from being inlined.

I've did some research and it seems like methods that contain exception handling won't be inlined but methods that throw exceptions still can be inlined. Therefore I'm committing suggestion.

Source:
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/dotnet/articles/ms973858(v=msdn.10)#highperfmanagedapps_topic10

> Methods that contain exception-handling blocks are not inlined, though methods that throw exceptions are still candidates for inlining.
